parameter.name: apikey
parameter.label: Rachio apikey
parameter.description: Visit Rachio Cloud Portal to create an apikey

parameter.name: pollingInterval
parameter.label: Polling/Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Seconds between fetching values from the cloud service

parameter.name: webhookVersion
parameter.label: Webhook Version
parameter.description: Version of webhook API to use. Legacy version only supports controllers but does support basic authentication so that it can be used with myopenhab.org proxy server. V2 version supports both controller and smart hose but does not support basic authentication so it must be used with a direct callback URL to your OpenHAB server which comes with some security risks.

options.option: V2 (controller + smart hose, no basic authentication)

parameter.name: webhookCallbackUrl
parameter.label: Callback URL
parameter.description: Callback URL for the new webhook. Rachio does not support basic authentication for this webhook and so it must be a direct URL to your OpenHAB server which comes with some security risks.
